content: स्रु €1 <ab>P.</ab> (स्रवति, स्रुत) .²1 To flow, stream, trickle, ooze, drop, exude; न हि निम्वात् स्रवेत् क्षौद्रम् <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 To pour out, shed, let flow; अलोठिष्ट च भूपृष्ठे शोणितं चाप्यसुस्रुवत् <ls>Bk. 15. 56</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">17. 18</ls>. .²3 To go, move. .²4 To trickle or slip away, waste away, perish, come to nothing; स्रवते ब्रह्म तस्यापि भिन्नभाण्डात् पयो यथा <ls>Bhāg.</ls>; <ls>Bk. 6. 18</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 74</ls>. .²5 To spread about, get abroad, transpire (as a secret). .²6 To slip, issue out before the right time. .²7 To accrue (as interest). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (स्रावयति-ते) .²1 To cause to flow, pour out, shed, spill (blood <ab>&c.</ab>); न गात्रात् स्रावयेदसृक् <ls>Ms. 4. 169</ls>. .²2 To stir up, arouse.
